investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimari Interactive (online gaming); Platform: AWS ap-southeast-1 (zones ap-southeast-1a/ap-southeast-1b/ap-southeast-1c); network range 10.5.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster nimari-prod-apsout (EKS); Database: players-db-01 holds players records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Dagster and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
